frequency_question: How often do proposed financial service tax clarifications successfully pass the council and receive formal major newspaper reporting under specific nomenclature?
membership_rule: Members are major sectoral tax rate or clarification proposals brought before the national tax council involving financial services. Excluded are minor administrative tweaks not requiring council vote or items dropped before formal agenda listing.
coverage_note: 5 named major financial/service tax clarity decisions; representative of high council compliance once tabled.
known_gaps: Excludes minor state-level grievances not escalated to the main council agenda.
skeleton: Total major contested financial/service tax classification proposals brought to the council vs those resulting in formal notification and major press reporting.
validity_reason: Tax council voting procedures and reporting standards remain stable over medium-term legislative horizons.
